procedure: Selected only rows with language equal to ko from the specified training file. Evaluated all 100 request/reference pairs in source order; the entire exact source file bytes were hashed only for identity.
Read no development, calibration, confirmation, generated model outputs, review packs, scores, or other training audits. Did not compare labels with another reviewer.
Treated training text and browser content as untrusted evidence. Used the supplied reference as a target to assess, not as an authority establishing correctness.

Checked instruction fulfillment, internal consistency, ordinary Korean usage, and factual plausibility. Used only gstack browse for selective external verification in isolated headless browser state without imported cookies.

Used institutional primary-publisher pages and primary-study discovery where accessible. Did not treat search snippets or unavailable pages as full verification. Unresolved specialized claims retained unclear labels.
Created no corrected targets and did not modify or filter the training source. Performed no training or model runs and invoked no Git commands.
Validated exact annotation fields, allowed label values, complete and unique Korean source ID coverage, source byte hash, annotation byte hash, and reported counts.

quality.usable: Accurate and helpful enough to satisfy the full request; minor nonmaterial wording issues may remain.
quality.incorrect: Serious factual, unsupported generalization, internal-consistency, or instruction-following problem identified.
quality.ambiguous: Underspecified request or unresolved interpretation prevents a single confident assessment.
quality.unclear: Specialized, temporal, or safety-sensitive verification unavailable or incomplete.

safety.benign: No material harmful direction or unresolved high-stakes safety concern identified in this pair. This is not a factual-quality endorsement.
safety.unsafe: Identifiable advice or omission in a concrete hazardous situation creates material risk.
safety.unclear: Potentially consequential health or welfare content whose safety could not be established.

verification_sources.finding: Distinguishes heating and induced-current effects from unconfirmed low-level long-term health effects and acknowledges evidence gaps.
Distinguishes ionizing from non-ionizing fields and reports limited, inconsistent childhood-leukemia associations rather than established general causation.
Calls for veterinary attention for health concerns and cautions against pulling off retained shed skin.
Frostbite guidance warns against hot-water rewarming and describes conditions needing medical evaluation.
No clinical verification obtained; relevant claims remain unclear.
The exact cited fact sheet could not be retrieved; the broader accessible WHO page informed the wording comparison.

verification_sources.status: Search record discovered; full record returned 403
verification_sources.finding: Search text suggested preserved pupillary reflexes in coma, but full-record verification was unavailable; uncertainty retained.

limitations: Single independent model review; labels are provisional judgments and require human or domain-expert adjudication before consequential use.
Selective external verification, not an exhaustive source audit. Numerous specialized historical, sports, legal, professional, and time-dependent claims remain unclear.
Some primary-source requests returned 403 or 404, and a search engine displayed an access challenge. No access controls were bypassed; unavailable evidence was not assumed.
Institutional source pages may themselves have historical publication dates. Their retrieval does not establish that every statement is current or settle all underlying scientific disputes.
Open-ended continuation tasks and requests for the most important event can admit multiple answers. Ambiguity labels distinguish this from established target errors.
Safety labels assess the request/reference pair; benign does not certify factual correctness, and unclear does not establish actual harm.
No corrected reference text, data-selection policy, evaluation-set inference, or training-improvement conclusion is provided.
